Tuesday 13 October 2026 · 24 stories
Morning Brief
Nifty 50 fell 0.70% to 22,363 on mixed breadth, 1,312 advancers to 1,231 decliners
Today’s read
The biggest names carried the session. The fifty most traded stocks returned +2.17% weighted by turnover, against +0.05% for the median stock, a gap of 2.1 percentage points, so most stocks did worse than the busiest names suggest.

Swaraj Engines Limited rose 8.7% on 211 times its usual volume. Its exchange filing that session was about quarterly results, “This is to inform that Board of Directors of Swaraj Engines Limited in their meeting held today on 12th October, 2026 has approved the Unaudited Financial Results of the…”.

Gallantt Ispat Limited rose 18.2% on 349 times its usual volume, and it was in the news with “Gallantt Ispat among 5 stocks showing RSI trending up”.

The exchange has formally asked 1 company to explain today's move: Gallantt Ispat Limited. Those queries were filed after the close, so they confirm the move rather than explain it. NSE's own surveillance flagged the same names.

Nothing in the news or in exchange filings explains the volume in Media Matrix Worldwide Limited (136x), Uday Jewellery Industries Limited (63x), D P Wires Limited (53x). That usually points to a sector story rather than a company one.
